name: Release v0.14.3
body:
## SkyPilot v0.14.3

Get it now with:

```bash
uv pip install "skypilot>=0.14.3"
```

---

## What's Changed
* [Docs] Job groups: rework 'Dynamically attaching jobs to a job group' for readability by @ishankaul1 in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10764
* [Dashboard] Add plugin slots for the Infra cell and field by @SeungjinYang in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10797
* [Docs] README: refresh the News section by @hopechong in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10795
* [Jobs] `include_tree` on the managed jobs queue: one fetch for a job and its dynamic tasks by @ishankaul1 in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10767
* [Kubernetes] Main containers being created after init containers finish are not a stall by @MadhavJivrajani in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10801
* [Server] Cap the storage the API server keeps file mounts on by @aylei in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10793
* [Core] Say when a queued launch was admitted by @DanielZhangQD in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10802
* [Metrics] Count WebSocket handshake attempts by @cg505 in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10688
* [Test] Stop shrinking test_api_server_start_stop below its declared size by @DanielZhangQD in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10805
* [Server] Spawn ssh-proxy subprocesses without forking the API server by @aylei in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10804
* [CI] Pin googleapis-common-protos<1.75.1 to match the protobuf 5.29.6 dev pin by @lloyd-brown in https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/pull/10808
